examples.item: The candidate answers the central proposition and the fear-to-trust cognitive progression.
It does not claim that late nights or oily food caused the reported stroke, that the AI advice is clinically accurate or safe, or that complete privacy is proven.
It directly answers whether the video is paid advertising as unknown and separates visible promotional framing from undisclosed compensation or control.
The diagnostic UI wording and its tension with reference/seek-care disclaimers are preserved without upgrading diagnostic ability.
The OCR-only opening recovery-state claim is retained as an unverified news-style screen claim.
Carrier conflicts, progress states, edited chronology, sensitive-data fields, privacy limits, and bounded CTA/service absences retain evidence and scope.
All 30 positive knowledge-unit statements are attached to transcript, frame, OCR, or scoped source evidence and keep material qualifications.
Corporate provenance, live-demo continuity, clinical suitability, improvement, privacy protection, and commercial relationship are not promoted to facts.
34 of 37 knowledge units keep every checked frame/OCR reference within the unit time range.
The recovery-state screen is localized to 4.633-5.7 seconds and the diagnostic wording to 40.0-56.667 seconds.
KU-25 and KU-36 cite opening OCR-00006 outside their later time ranges; KU-28 cites the 38.733-second TARGET-0036 outside its closing-only time range.

The candidate preserves unknowns for case authenticity and causation, clinical validation, presenter/data identity, demo continuity, professional standards, privacy controls, commercial control, longitudinal outcome, access conditions, and media authorization.
It does not separately state whether the opening narration accurately quotes a doctor or reporter; the broader source/authenticity boundary remains present.
